basic_profile.bio: I'm a 42-year-old gamer and pop culture enthusiast based in Toronto, Canada. By day, I work as a software developer specializing in mobile apps, and by night, I dive deep into the world of retro gaming and obscure internet memes. Married for 10 years, my spouse shares my passion for gaming and we often attend conventions together. When I'm not gaming, I enjoy exploring sneaker culture and collecting rare pairs. I typically browse Reddit during late evenings and weekends, using it as a platform to connect with like-minded individuals and stay updated on niche interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having a degree in Computer Science from the University of Toronto, my tech knowledge is robust. I've been coding since the late '90s and have a keen interest in retro gaming, which I learned through countless hours of gameplay and community interaction. My expertise extends to sneakers, cultivated through years of personal collection and engagement with sneakerhead forums.
